transition_rule: A valid returned result SHALL either advance through every downstream state automatically or fail closed with a protected infrastructure blocker. It SHALL NOT require a human or conversational agent to move evidence, wake another controller, create the next bounded task, or reconcile campaign state.
adjudication_rule: Trusted assignment-specific replay may promote only what it verifies. If no trusted mathematical replay adapter can establish the returned claim, automated bounded adjudication SHALL preserve the evidence, promote no mathematical claim, and generate a replay-closure successor instead of stopping.
successor_rule: ADJUDICATED is not terminal for an open hill. ADVANCED requires either a protected successor assignment or a protected terminal hill disposition.
completion_test: Starting from the protected H2 WP02 returned RESULT/1 fixture, one unattended lifecycle invocation must reproduce capture identity, independently replay both accepted witnesses, derive the bounded narrowed adjudication, identify WP03 as successor, and emit ADVANCED with no human-supplied intermediate state.
